# BirdSoc SG Shop

> The official online shop of the Bird Society of Singapore (UEN T23SS0038A). Browse and buy bird-society merchandise, register for events, and make donations. Payment is via PayNow. Order collection and event details are managed through the site.

## Shop

- [Home](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/): Featured products and shop highlights
- [Products](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/products): Full merchandise catalogue
- [Cart](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/cart): Review items before checkout
- [Checkout](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/checkout): Place an order and pay via PayNow

## Events

- [Events](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/events): Upcoming Bird Society events open for registration
- [Event details](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/events/:id): Information and registration for a specific event

## Donations

- [Donate](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/donate): Support the Bird Society of Singapore with a donation

## Account & Orders

- [Login](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/login): Sign in to your account
- [Register](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/register): Create a new account
- [Orders](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/orders): View your past orders (sign-in required)

## Help

- [FAQ](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/faq): Frequently asked questions
- [Contact](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/contact): Get in touch with the shop team
- [Refund policy](https://shop.birdsociety.sg/refund): How refunds and returns work

## About the Bird Society

- [About us](https://birdsociety.sg/about-us/): About the Bird Society of Singapore
- [Support us](https://birdsociety.sg/support-us/): Ways to support the society
- [Data protection notice](https://birdsociety.sg/data-protection-notice/): How personal data is handled
